The '''Chem-Basin Ditchlands''' was a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] that was the site of the [[Chem-Basin Mine]]. The Ditchlands were located south of the [[Republic Operational Headquarters]], and west of the complex surrounding [[Attis Station]].<ref name="TOR" />
